title: 第二十五章 无辜被殴打第二十六章 在遇雪迪艾兰和她的侄女
content_zh:
“终于让欧斯派恩认可加入，不过他为什么突然认可我呢，真是奇怪啊！而且为什么有那么多我无法看到的信息呢？”颜铁龙一边走向旅店小花园走去，一边内心考虑脑子里的信息。
“系统能不能告诉我为什么我无法看到欧斯派恩部分信息呢？”颜铁龙内心对系统询问道。
颜铁龙停下脚步等待脑子里的系统回复，可惜他等了一会儿，也没有等到系统的回复就叹了一口气道：“嗨～，我都忘了，我这个系统根本就不会回复。”。
颜铁龙刚要踏步，突然他的脑子里出现二个字就脱口而出道：“阅历！”。
“阅历，这个系统还真是坑啊，等等！！！系统居然回复我了。”颜铁龙先是抱怨系统，突然注意到系统回复就变的一副震惊的样子。
“系统能不能告诉我阅历要到几星才能完整查看欧斯派恩的信息？”颜铁龙对系统询问着。
“靠！系统又不回复了，算了，还是先去小花园散散心，在说吧。”颜铁龙等了一会，还是没有等到系统回复就决定回小花园看看。
花园里只有琪莉米丝坐着摇椅并用身边的小桌上的玻璃杯喝着红色液体，她独自一个人欣赏星空，同时小桌子上已经有六瓶空荡荡的酒瓶。
当颜铁龙到来小花园之时，琪莉米丝有点醉意对颜铁龙问道：“铁龙，要不要来一杯？”。
颜铁龙听到琪莉米丝的询问就来到琪莉米丝面前，当他看到桌子上的一瓶已经只剩下一半的酒，就给自己倒了一杯问道：“琪莉米丝大婶，不会只是单单请我喝酒吧？”。
“这么，！婶婶请你喝酒，一定要有事才会请你吗？”琪莉米丝脸霞出现一丝醉酒的红晕，但是她听到颜铁熊的话，就语气不满的问道。
“没，我没那个意思！”颜铁龙听出琪莉米丝大婶的不满的语气，就急忙回应道。
“铁龙，我问你当年婶婶赶你出旅店，你恨婶婶吗？”琪莉米丝从摇椅站了起来，身体有点摇晃，但是她说话的语气充满着认真问道。
“琪莉米丝，您喝多了！还是先回房休息吧。”颜铁龙看到琪莉米丝摇晃的样子，就急忙搀扶琪莉米丝的手道。
“我没有醉！”琪莉米丝一下摔开颜铁熊搀扶的手大声道。
琪莉米丝又快速抓住颜铁龙衣领打了一个酒嗝神情认真的问道：“铁龙，你还没有告诉婶婶当年，你恨不恨我？”。
颜铁龙将琪莉米扶到摇椅上道：“琪莉米丝婶婶，当年我的确没有恨您，只是向跟您解释当年那一场误会，只是您根本就不给我这个机会，最后我听从了爱丝娜姑姑的意见，去外面学习一段时间，同时等您气消在回来解释，只是没想到我这一走就二年时间。”。
“铁龙当年是婶婶的不对，不过也不能怪婶婶心狠，当年艾雪那孩子刚开始明明很不待见你，可是后来她慢慢的转变了跟你的态度，开始喜欢找你玩，后来跟着你身后喊你哥哥。
当时我觉得艾雪跟莉莉一样只是把你当成亲哥哥一样看到待，可是后来我注意到艾雪对你的眼神跟莉莉不一样了，我就注意到她对你已经产生了朦朦胧胧爱意。”琪莉米丝借着酒意说到这里之时，颜铁龙团急忙打断道：“琪莉米丝婶婶，我真的只是将琪莉艾雪当自己亲妹妹，我真的没有对她有其他的念头。”。
“这个我知道，当年我想过让艾雪成为你的妻子，不过当年你心性不稳定，我不想让艾雪跟我一样，等了十几年还在这里等他。

所以我想让艾雪跟你分开一段，同时希望在这一段时间里希望她把你忘了，只是让我没有想到，我会亲眼看到你们做那么亲密的动作，当然事后我才知道那是一场误会。
可是我不得不为我女儿未来的着想，于是我就将我女儿关了起来，并在旅馆里散播你调戏我女儿这件事以及拒绝跟你相见。
现在想想，要是我当年那么多事，说不定女艾雪也不会躲着我学魔法，也不会一直不肯来见我，艾雪妈妈错了，妈妈好想你！！！”琪莉米丝说到伤心处，直接拿起小桌上的酒大口大口喝起来。
“琪莉米丝婶婶，你真的醉了！”颜铁龙看到琪莉米丝喝的那么凶就急忙将酒瓶夺了过来并说道。
“给我！把酒给我！！”琪莉米丝语气带着威胁道。
啪！“抱歉琪莉米丝婶婶，我没有拿稳！”颜铁龙看到琪莉米丝靠近，就灵机一动让拿酒的手一滑，让酒瓶掉地摔碎，同时颜铁龙语气带着抱歉对摇摇晃晃过来的琪莉米丝道。
content_en:
"I finally got Ospine to agree to join, but why did he suddenly agree to me? It's really strange! And why is there so much information that I can't see?" Yan Tielong walked towards the small garden of the hotel while thinking about the information in his mind.
"Can the system tell me why I can't see some of Ospine's information?" Yan Tielong asked the system in his heart.
Yan Tielong stopped and waited for the system's reply in his mind. Unfortunately, he waited for a while, but before the system's reply, he sighed and said, "Hey~, I forgot about it. This system of mine won't reply at all."
Just as Yan Tielong was about to take a step forward, two words suddenly appeared in his mind and he blurted out: "Experience!".
"Experience, this system is really a scam, wait a minute!!! The system actually replied to me." Yan Tielong first complained about the system, but suddenly became shocked when he noticed the system's reply.
"Can the system tell me how many levels of experience I need to have before I can fully view Ospine's information?" Yan Tielong asked the system.
"Damn! The system didn't reply again. Forget it, let's go to the small garden to relax first. Let's talk." Yan Tielong waited for a while, but decided to go back to the small garden to have a look before the system responded.
Only Kirimis was sitting in the rocking chair in the garden and drinking red liquid from a glass on the small table next to her. She was admiring the starry sky alone. At the same time, there were six empty wine bottles on the small table.
When Yan Tielong came to the small garden, Qilimis was a little drunk and asked Yan Tielong: "Tielong, do you want a drink?".
Yan Tielong came to Qilimis when he heard Qilimis's inquiry. When he saw a bottle of wine on the table that was only half full, he poured himself a glass and asked: "Aunt Qilimis, won't you just treat me to a drink?".
"So! Auntie invites you to drink. Do you have to have something to do before I invite you?" Qilimis had a drunken blush on her face, but when she heard Yan Tiexiong's words, she asked in a dissatisfied tone.
"No, I didn't mean that!" Yan Tielong responded hurriedly after hearing Aunt Qilimis's dissatisfied tone.
"Tie Long, let me ask you, did you hate your aunt when she kicked you out of the hotel?" Kirimis stood up from the rocking chair, her body swaying a little, but her tone of voice was full of seriousness when she asked.
"Qilimis, you drank too much! It's better to go back to your room and rest first." Yan Tielong saw Qilimis shaking and hurriedly supported Qilimis's hand.
"I'm not drunk!" Qilimis shouted loudly as she threw away Yan Tiexiong's holding hand.
Qilimis quickly grabbed Yan Tielong's collar and gave him a wine burp. She asked seriously: "Tielong, you haven't told your aunt yet, did you hate me back then?".
Yan Tielong helped Qilimi to the rocking chair and said: "Aunt Qilimis, I did not hate you back then. I just wanted to explain the misunderstanding to you, but you didn't give me this chance at all. In the end, I listened to Aunt Esna's advice and went to study outside for a while while waiting for you to calm down and come back to explain. But I didn't expect that it would only be two years since I left."
"Tie Long was aunt's fault back then, but you can't blame her for being cruel. That kid Ai Xue clearly didn't like you at first, but then she slowly changed her attitude towards you and started to like to play with you. Later, she followed you and called you brother.
At that time, I thought that Ai Xue, like Lily, only treated you as a biological brother, but then I noticed that Ai Xue looked at you differently from Lily, and I noticed that she had developed a vague love for you. "When Qilimis said this under the influence of alcohol, Yan Tielongtuan hurriedly interrupted: "Aunt Qilimis, I really only regard Qili Aishue as my own sister. I really have no other thoughts about her. ".
"I know this. Back then I thought about letting Ai XueI want to be your wife, but you were mentally unstable back then, and I don’t want Ai Xue to be like me, waiting here for him after more than ten years.
So I wanted Ai Xue to separate from you for a while, and at the same time, I hoped that she would forget about you during this period of time. But I didn't expect that I would see you doing such intimate actions with my own eyes. Of course, I didn't know until afterwards that it was a misunderstanding.
But I had to think about my daughter's future, so I locked my daughter up, spread the news in the hotel that you were teasing my daughter, and refused to see you.
Now think about it, if I had been so troubled back then, maybe my daughter Ai Xue would not have avoided me to learn magic, nor would she have been refusing to come to see me. Ai Xue’s mother was wrong, I miss you so much! ! ! "Qilimis said that she was sad, and she directly picked up the wine on the small table and drank heavily.
“Aunt Kirimis, you are really drunk! "When Yan Tielong saw Qilimis drinking so hard, he quickly grabbed the bottle and said.
"Give it to me! Give me the wine! ! "Qilimis said with a threatening tone.
Snap! “Sorry Aunt Kirimis, I wasn’t sure! "When Yan Tielong saw Qilimis approaching, he had an idea and let the hand holding the wine slip, causing the bottle to fall to the ground and break. At the same time, Yan Tielong said to Qilimis who was staggering over with an apologetic tone.
